title: Spacing-Uniform Lattice Inequalities Cannot Produce the Yang-Mills Mass Gap: paper, audit and Lean certificate
description: RevTeX paper and Lean 4/Mathlib certificate. Proves that a lattice gap uniform in lattice units forces vanishing continuum two-point functions, records volume, cumulant, Bianchi, running-coupling and curvature obstructions, audits eight manuscripts, and states the open residual (Hypothesis R). The Yang-Mills existence and mass-gap problem remains open. Lean: 20 main theorems, no sorry, standard axioms only.
